items.title: AI Rumpelstiltskin goes 'Tip Toein' In My Jordans'
items.summary: An AI-generated clip styled like a 1980s fantasy film, an imp tiptoeing around a crying woman in a barn before turning the straw into gold, was set to Riff Raff's 'Tip Toe Wing In My Jawwdinz' and took over feeds; one Oct 5 post asking what it was ('I am literally seeing it EVERYWHERE') drew 11,000 likes. Viewers hunted for the 'old movie' it came from before explainers confirmed it was AI, and users swapped in everyone from Supernatural's Sam and Dean to Asmongold.
items.author: @SharrellAnne2

references.title: Creepy backstory behind 'Rumpelstiltskin tiptoe' man that's taking over the internet

post.name: SharrellAnne
post.text: Can somebody please explain this to me? I am literally seeing it EVERYWHERE, and every single time, it sends a chill down my spine. I have no idea what it is about this creepy little thing, but something about it is deeply unsettling. 😭
